notes: *And when* is one rendering of the opening waw under rule 55's pair sentence, headed on the coordinator, so the apodosis waw before `וַיֹּאמֶר` is what goes unrendered (rule 14).
`בֵּית מִיכָה` is recast as an English possessive, so the construct keeps *house* and the name takes the possessive form (rule 29); the supplied *into* is the bare goal nominal's under rule 33.
`פֶּסֶל הָאֵפוֹד` writes a *the* before each noun, so nothing is fronted and each determiner goes to the word it stands before (rule 29).
